name: Crewe Favourites 2025

venue.name: Crewe Alexandra Football Club
venue.address: Mornflake Stadium, Gresty Road, Crewe, Cheshire, CW2 6EB

information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ**, **Important Information** and the **[Favourites Competition Format](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFavourites2025#48813-favourites-competition-format)** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

PLEASE NOTE: For this competition, you're only allowed to compete in 5 different WCA events.

If you are competing in both [Crewe Favourites 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFavourites2025) and [Crewe FMC Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CreweFMCDay2025), you'll be eligible for a £10 refund on your registration. For example, competing in one of the two competitions would cost you £20, and competing in both competitions would cost you £40 in registration fee upfront, but £30 in total, as you'll get £10 back after the competition.
